title: 第三章 再遇仇敌！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

跟陈若彤走出盛宝楼，坐上豪华大奔，二十分钟后，他们到了珠宝大会会场，泉城尧舜大厦。

一到大厦一楼，叶凡眼神一亮，他看到无数展柜和展厅，上面各扯着横幅，有黄金楼，玉华阁等名字，都是泉城本地珠宝大亨。

“这次大会是泉城珠宝业的一次聚会，咱们盛宝楼是发起者之一，我得去招呼一下其他老总，你在这四处看看，看完后告诉我哪些有价值。”

陈若彤道，叶凡点头，“好的陈总。”

看到叶凡答应，陈若彤离开，叶凡四处观察。

随着观察，他眼神亮了，他发现，望气术真有用！

不管他看中什么原石，这块原石内部翡翠都会出现在他眼前！

“这是…蒙头料，最低级别原石，一公斤也就一二百，不过这块却蕴含很多糯种翡翠，要是买下，绝对能赚五倍以上！”

“这是普通糯种原石，一公斤快一千了，不过这块却蕴含许多成品糯冰种，嗯，买下来也能小赚。”

“还有这块…这块…”

一幅幅翡翠画面在他脑中浮现，叶凡越来越兴奋！

“好…太好了！有这望气术，我还怕发不了家？至于江灵，哼，你不就是因为钱才和王岩好的么？很快，我会超越他！”

脑中浮现两张讨厌的脸，叶凡握紧拳头。

“叶凡！我正他妈想找你呢！你居然在这！好啊！张师父，给我拿下！”

怒吼传出，叶凡转身，看到自己最讨厌的两人。

王岩和江灵！

同时，他余光看见有个黑衣中年人向他走来。

他眼睛一眯，感到一股危险。

“叮！”

“系统检测到有敌人靠近宿主！”

“敌人强度，明劲中期，一拳具备500公斤力量！”

“触发系统任务！再度雪耻！击溃此明劲中期强者，摧毁王岩信心！”

“任务理由，虽宿主比敌人弱一级别，但宿主身怀望气术，凭此术，宿主可具备远超常人感知反应，足以让宿主完成越级挑战！”

看到讯息，叶凡眼神一亮。

他没想到，系统会发布任务！

他运转望气术！

世界在他眼中慢下来！

四周的人脚步慢了，那走来的张师父动作慢了！

叶凡眼神一亮，对张师父面门轰出一拳！

张师父脸色一变，同样轰出一拳。

“嗯！居然能反应过来，明劲中期强者，果然不简单！”

叶凡瞳孔一缩，他昨天打王岩保镖时，他们做不出任何反应，这明劲中期竟做出反应，自然他知道厉害。

“不过我有望气术，就算你比我强，但你反应哪有我快？”

Page (1/3)

Following Chen Ruotong, they walked out of Shengbao Building and got on the luxurious Mercedes. Twenty minutes later, they arrived at the venue of the jewelry conference, Quancheng Yao and Shun Building.

As soon as he arrived on the first floor of the building, Ye Fan's eyes lit up. He saw countless showcases and exhibition halls with banners hanging on them. There were names such as Golden Building and Yuhua Pavilion. They were all local jewelry tycoons in Quancheng.

"This conference is a gathering of the Quancheng jewelry industry. Our Shengbao Tower is one of the initiators. I have to go greet the other bosses. Take a look around here and tell me what is valuable after reading it."

Chen Ruotong said, Ye Fan nodded, "Okay, Mr. Chen."

Seeing Ye Fan agree, Chen Ruotong left, and Ye Fan looked around.

As he observed, his eyes brightened, and he discovered that the aura technique was really useful!

No matter what rough stone he likes, the jade inside the rough stone will appear in front of his eyes!

"This is... head covering material. The lowest grade rough stone only costs one or two hundred per kilogram. However, this piece contains a lot of waxy jadeite. If you buy it, you will definitely make more than five times the profit!"

"This is an ordinary rough waxy stone. One kilogram costs almost a thousand, but this piece contains many finished glutinous ice seeds. Well, you can make a small profit by buying it."

"And this piece...this piece..."

Pictures of emeralds appeared in his mind, and Ye Fan became more and more excited!

"Okay...great! With this Qi-gazing technique, I'm still afraid that I won't be able to make a fortune? As for Jiang Ling, huh, isn't it just because of money that you are close to Wang Yan? Soon, I will surpass him!"

Two annoying faces appeared in his mind, and Ye Fan clenched his fists.

"Ye Fan! I was just fucking looking for you! You're actually here! Okay! Master Zhang, get it for me!"

The roar came out, and Mark turned around and saw the two people he hated the most.

Wang Yan and Jiang Ling!

At the same time, from the corner of his eye, he saw a middle-aged man in black walking towards him.

He narrowed his eyes and felt a sense of danger.

"Ding!"

"The system has detected an enemy approaching the host!"

"The enemy's strength is in the middle stage of Ming Jin. One punch has 500 kilograms of power!"

"Trigger system mission! Avenge shame again! Defeat this mid-level Mingjin powerhouse and destroy Wang Yan's confidence!"

"The reason for the mission is that although the host is one level weaker than the enemy, the host possesses the art of hope. With this art, the host can have far superior sensory reactions than ordinary people, which is enough for the host to complete the leapfrog challenge!"

Ye Fan's eyes lit up when he saw the message.

He didn't expect that the system would issue a task!

He runs the qi-watching technique!

The world slows down in his eyes!

The people around him moved slowly, and the approaching Master Zhang moved slowly!

Ye Fan's eyes lit up and he punched Master Zhang in the face!

Master Zhang's expression changed and he also punched.

"Yeah! I can actually react to it. A strong person in the middle stage of Mingjin is really not easy!"

Ye Fan's pupils shrank. When he beat Wang Yan's bodyguards yesterday, they couldn't react at all. But Ming Jinzhong actually reacted. Naturally, he knew how powerful they were.

"But I have ki magic. Even if you are stronger than me, how can your reaction be as fast as mine?"
